Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Body, health & movement

dive verb

headfirst

also dive in headfirst, dive headfirst, jump in headfirst

modern

Traupman 50, 305

praeceps saliō

dive in headfirst

Examples

  • ālīsque plaudentēs praecipitēs alia post aliam in aquam dēsiliēbant ibique celerrimē natābant

    and, flapping their wings, they dived headfirst into the water one after another and swam very fast thereLibellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

Other words

  • praeceps dēsiliō — dive in headfirst

    also used · modern · Traupman 50, 305

See also jump, dive, swimming pool, diving board.

SourcesLewis & Short: praeceps

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 50, 305, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).
